freshness_method: All selected IDs are planned as fresh deliberate targets; guarded promotion must independently check them against all canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-12 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: modification or edit that changes an existing setting, text, or design
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives تبدیلی/تغیر and English amendment, modification, alteration; ترمیم کرنا includes modify/amend/improve.

targets.intended_sense: additional or extra beyond what is already present
targets.external_evidence: Project lexicon source meaning is extra/additional; learner use is limited to an additional interface option.

targets.intended_sense: attached or connected, especially a file attached to another item or message
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives نتھی کیا ہوا، ساتھ لگایا ہوا، وابستہ، جڑا ہوا and English appended/annexed/filed.

targets.intended_sense: sensitive; information requiring special care because exposure or misuse can have consequences
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta supports sensitive/quickly affected; current Urdu privacy terminology from Google explicitly uses حساس ذاتی معلومات for sensitive personal information.

targets.intended_sense: caution or careful consideration before acting
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines سمجھ سوچ کر اقدام یا فیصلہ, غور و تامل, ہوشیاری, and protection from harm.

targets.intended_sense: awareness or informed understanding of what is happening and why it matters
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives آگاہی پانا/رکھنا as becoming or being informed/acquainted, and آگاہی دینا as informing someone.

targets.intended_sense: repair or making a damaged/malfunctioning thing work correctly again
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines ٹوٹی پھوٹی یا ناقص چیز کی درستی and English repairing/rectifying/mending.

targets.intended_sense: storage; a place or system where information is kept
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines storing/stock/store; its Urdu entry for storage explicitly includes the electronic process of storing information on a computer.

targets.intended_sense: absent, missing, or no longer visible where expected
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives غیر موجود، غیر حاضر and English absent/lost/vanished.

targets.intended_sense: analysis; examining parts, observations, or evidence to understand a problem
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives English analysis and related تجزیہ کرنا as using آثار/علائم/قرائن to determine the nature or reality of something.

targets.intended_sense: connected or coherently related so that pieces of information support one another
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives وابستہ/پیوستہ and figurative مسلسل، رواں, with مربوط ہونا meaning linked to one another.
Rekhta gives تعین کیا ہوا، مقرر، یقینی، طے شدہ and English decided/fixed/determined.

targets.intended_sense: communication or conveying a message/information to an intended audience
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines بات، پیغام، خیالات یا علوم دوسرے تک بھیجنے یا پہنچانے کا عمل and English communication/conveying/sending.

targets.intended_sense: weakness, defect, or vulnerable point in a process/system
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta includes خرابی، کمی، نقص، خامی and English weakness/ineffectualness.

targets.intended_sense: incomplete or deficient because a necessary part is missing or faulty
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives ادھورا، نامکمل، ناتمام and English defective/deficient/imperfect/lacking.

generation_guardrails: Use durable technology concepts rather than brand-specific or rapidly aging product facts.
Constructed scenarios must not imply that repair guarantees data recovery or that one permission/storage pattern applies to every product.
P1-P5 introduce exactly three new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all fifteen.
All six passages retain ten questions and ten linked answers, with a 220-320 whitespace-token B1 passage band.
Learner-facing title, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
